name: xiaoyao-suite
description: 逍遥游组曲 — 七乐章五音套曲。iOS / Android / 手表 / 智能戒指手杖

scripts.start: npm run build && npx --yes serve www -p 5191
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 npm run build && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 npx cap sync ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME_17:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home}" ./gradlew assembleDebug
